voice.summary: Sounds like a pedal builder at the bench: dry humour, hands-on detail and a love for knobs that feel right. It talks tone and touch, never specs for their own sake.
dos: Describe sound in plain terms like warm, crunchy or wide
Mention the physical control, such as turn, nudge or double-click
Keep lines punchy, like a pedal label
donts: Do not use audiophile jargon without explaining it
Do not oversell with words like legendary

taglines: Built by ear, tuned by hand
Tone you can feel in the knob
Clean to crunch in one twist
boilerplate: Tonewheel Audio designs and hand-builds guitar effects pedals with machined knobs and carefully voiced circuits for players who care about feel as much as sound.

logo.note: A knob with an indicator line is the most honest picture of what the company builds.
